findings.source_quote: Adorn: to deck or beautify; set off; to embellish by anything external or adventitious; to display the beauty or excellence of.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the headword and the gloss label into Bahasa Indonesia and preserve the gloss meaning. For example: "Hiasan / Adorn: menghias atau mempercantik; menonjolkan; menghias dengan sesuatu yang bersifat luar atau kebetulan; menampilkan kecantikan atau keunggulan." (or simply "Hiasan:" if you prefer a single Indonesian headword). Ensure the label is not left in English and keep the gloss text as currently translated.
findings.translation_quote: Adorn: menghias atau mempercantik; menonjolkan; menghias dengan sesuatu yang bersifat luar atau kebetulan; menampilkan kecantikan atau keunggulan.

findings.location: Multiple glossary/definition headings throughout the article (e.g., paragraph headings: "Plaiting:", "Apparel:", "Ornament:", "Meek:", "Quiet:", "Subjection:", "Afraid:", "Amazement:", "Entangleth:", "Shun:", "Profane:", "Vain:", "Babblings:", "Flee:", "Lusts:", "Righteousness:", "Faith:", "Charity:", "Peace:", "Pure:", "Shamefacedness:", "Sobriety:") — corresponding headings in translation remain in English (e.g. "Plaiting:", "Apparel:", etc.).
findings.source_quote: Plaiting: folding, doubling, braiding. / Apparel: clothing; external habiliments or decorations. / Ornament: That which embellishes; or something which, added to another thing, renders it most beautiful to the eye. / Meek: mild of temper; ... (etc.)
findings.suggested_fix: Translate each English gloss heading into standard Bahasa Indonesia while keeping the explanatory gloss in Indonesian as already done. Example replacements: "Plaiting:" → "Mengepang:" or "Pelipatan (Plaiting):", "Apparel:" → "Pakaian:", "Ornament:" → "Perhiasan:", "Meek:" → "Lemah lembut:", "Quiet:" → "Tenang:", etc. Keep the existing Indonesian definitions; only change the heading words so no substantive English glossary terms remain.
findings.translation_quote: Plaiting: melipat, menggandakan, mengepang. / Apparel: pakaian; atribut luar atau hiasan luar. / Ornament: sesuatu yang memperindah; atau sesuatu yang, bila ditambahkan ke sesuatu yang lain, menjadikannya paling indah di mata. / Meek: lemah lembut dalam tabiat; lunak; lembut; tidak mudah terpancing atau tersinggung; bersikap sabar, tahan terhadap luka. (etc.)

findings.location: Paragraph defining "Quiet" (translation.html): "Quiet: tenang; ...; tidak menimbulkan offense; ..."
findings.source_quote: Quiet: still; being in a state of rest; not moving; peaceable; not turbulent; not giving offence; not exciting controversy, disorder, or trouble; mild; meek; contented.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the remaining English word "offence" with an appropriate Indonesian equivalent. For example: "... tidak menimbulkan rasa tersinggung; ..." or "... tidak menimbulkan penghinaan/menyinggung; ..." Keep the rest of the translated definition intact and in Indonesian.
findings.translation_quote: Quiet: tenang; berada dalam keadaan istirahat; tidak bergerak; damai; tidak bergolak; tidak menimbulkan offense; tidak membangkitkan kontroversi, kekacauan, atau masalah; lemah lembut; tunduk; puas.
